gitHooks.name: pre-commit
gitHooks.description: Run quality gates on staged files before commit

gitHooks.name: pre-push
gitHooks.description: Run quality gates and type-check before push
appendCommands: command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 && git lfs pre-push "$@" || true

gitHooks.name: post-checkout
gitHooks.command: command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 && git lfs post-checkout "$@" || true

gitHooks.name: post-merge
gitHooks.command: command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 && git lfs post-merge "$@" || true
